title: Adopter config — project-management capability
description: Formal shape of the adopter's `project/config.yaml` — the one file every project-management adopter hand-edits at install time (default branch, `gh:` host/owner per DEC-023, Projects-v2 board flags + cached ids, doc-path mappings per DEC-015, milestone categories per DEC-016, review mode + registered agents per DEC-027 / DEC-028, methodology-mesh peers per DEC-022). `additionalProperties: false` is load-bearing: every reader accesses this file through defensive `.get()`, so an unknown or misspelled key would otherwise be silently ignored and degrade behaviour (e.g. `has_projects_v2_boards` with a trailing `s` falls back to label mode unnoticed) — the schema turns that into a loud refusal naming the offending key. Required keys mirror `pre-check.py`'s REQUIRED_ADOPTER_CONFIG_FIELDS so shape validation and the pre-check gate agree. Document-shaped schema: the file IS the resource (no top-level id collection). Companion per COR-018.

binds_to.description: Repo-relative globs matching the adopter-data files this schema validates (COR-023 fallback binding). Present on the kit-shipped binding carrier; absent from adopter data files.

pkit_schema.description: Self-describing adopter-data binding tag, `project-management:config` (COR-023). Optional on adopter files (the binds_to glob resolves them either way).

default_branch.description: The repo's default branch. Drives branch-name generation and base-branch enforcement per DEC-013; pre-check verifies it matches the live repo.

workstreams.description: LEGACY shim. The canonical workstream taxonomy lives in `project/workstreams.yaml` per DEC-018; this key survives because `pre-check.py` still lists it in REQUIRED_ADOPTER_CONFIG_FIELDS and readers accept it as a fallback. Both historical shapes are accepted: the v0.2.0 bare list of slugs and the v0.5.0 mapping form. An empty list is the normal value once the taxonomy has moved to its own file.

gh.description: GitHub host + owner targeting per DEC-023. Both fields optional; absence delegates to ambient `gh` state. Config wins over ambient.

host.description: The host every `gh` shell-out targets, threaded as `GH_HOST`. `gh issue create` infers the host from the remote but `gh api` does not, so scripts hitting raw endpoints need it explicitly. Omit on single-org github.com.

default_owner.description: Owner spliced as `--owner` on cross-owner operations (board / org / cross-owner labels). Omit when the board lives in the repo's own owner.

has_projects_v2_board.description: True when classification axes live as Projects v2 board fields; false (or absent) selects label-fallback mode per DEC-012, where bootstrap creates `priority:*` / `workstream:*` / `state:*` labels instead. Set `projects_v2_board_id` alongside a true value.

projects_v2_board_id.description: The board NUMBER (as shown by `gh project list`), not its node id. Read whenever `has_projects_v2_board` is true; pre-check fails when the flag is set and this is absent.

projects_v2_node_id.description: Cached GraphQL node id for the board (`PVT_…`), populated at adoption time by bootstrap so `create-issue` skips a per-create `gh project view` round-trip. Purely a cache: absent means live-resolve.

pre_close_triage_lead_days.description: Lead time in days for pre-close triage of a time-bound container per DEC-016.

code_path_to_doc_mapping.description: Code-path → doc-path couplings checked by `check-doc-mapping` per DEC-015 + ADR-019. Opt-in: absent or `enforce: false` reports would-fire mappings and exits 0. Keep broad tree→README rules advisory; enforce only surgical 1:1 couplings.

enforce.description: True hard-rejects (exit 1) when mapped code changed without the mapped doc. Defaults to false (advisory). The real boundary is wiring the check as a required CI status; the merge-pr layer is only a speed-bump (ADR-004).

rules.description: The couplings. No rules configured means the check skips.

milestone_categories.description: Declared milestone categories per DEC-016. A project that files Milestones must declare at least one category first — the methodology ships no implicit default, and filing outside a declared category is a hard reject. Keys are the category names `create-milestone <category>` accepts.

review.description: Review-mode configuration per DEC-027 (mode + human reviewer role) and DEC-028 (the two agent-as-approver paths). Absent means mode=agent with no agents registered.

mode.description: Project default review mode — the lowest of DEC-027's three override layers (a `review:agent` / `review:human` issue label beats it; `--require-human` beats both). Defaults to `agent` when unset.

reviewer_role.description: Role from the membership roster whose members are requested as reviewers (the PR author is excluded).

agents.description: Registered reviewer agents per DEC-028. Both lists optional; at least one entry across them is needed for the agent gate to be satisfiable.

remote_registered.description: Remote path — agents with their own GitHub identity (bot, App, service account). Still singleton at v1: DEC-032 lifted the cap on the local path only.

github_login.description: The agent's GitHub login; a verdict comment authored by it satisfies the gate (author-exclusion enforced).

local_registered.description: Local path — harness-deployed agents. N ≥ 2 is valid since DEC-032 lifted the singleton cap; the resolved required set is this baseline unioned with capability-contributed reviewers.

name.description: Agent name; must correspond to a deployed agent file (`.claude/agents/<name>.md` on the Claude Code adapter). pre-check refuses a registered name with no deployed file — an unsatisfiable merge gate.

mesh_peers.description: Peer repos whose methodology-shared state `check-mesh` compares against per DEC-022. Absent (together with `mesh_source`) skips the mesh check.

mesh_source.description: Single governance-repo pointer, an alternative to (and combinable with) `mesh_peers` per DEC-022. Dereferencing is deferred at v1 — treated as one more peer.

repo_owner.description: Owner segment of this repo, used by `check-mesh` when reporting local state. Optional — the live repo is otherwise resolved through `gh`.

repo_name.description: Name segment of this repo, used by `check-mesh` when reporting local state. Optional — the live repo is otherwise resolved through `gh`.

workstream_slug.description: Kebab-case workstream slug, matching the shape workstreams.yaml declares (DEC-018).

peer_uri.description: A mesh peer, `github://<owner>/<repo>[/<path>]` (DEC-022). `check-mesh` exits with a usage error on any other form.

doc_mapping_rule.description: One code→doc coupling. Both fields are required: `check-doc-mapping` silently skips a rule missing either, so an incomplete rule is a rule that never fires.

code.description: Gitignore-style glob over the code surface. When a diff touches it, at least one mapped doc must be in the same diff.

docs.description: The doc paths (or globs) that satisfy the rule. Any one of them being in the diff is enough.

milestone_category.description: One declared milestone category per DEC-016. `create-milestone` refuses a category that is not a mapping carrying both required fields.

title_format.description: Title template `create-milestone` formats, e.g. `Milestone {n}: {name}`. The command substitutes the computed number and the supplied name.

close_trigger_default.description: Close trigger applied to instances of this category unless `--close-trigger` overrides it. Each Milestone carries the resolved value as its `Close trigger:` first body line.

description.description: One-line prose stating what this category means in this project.
